name: Alcanar (Spain)
description: White field charged with three dark green eradicated reeds, with a red stripe along the fly bearing a white Maltese cross.
history: The official flag of Alcanar is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with the three dark green eradicated reeds of the arms, the whole 21/28 of the height and 8/21 of the length of the cloth; approved by the Generalitat on 24 March 2014 and published in the DOGC on 3 April 2014.

features.role: Maltese cross on the red fly stripe
